claims.claim: A minimal-dependency Rust server starts in well under a second
claims.why: Both measured Rust servers started in about 0.24 s, which is well under a second.

claims.claim: A minimal-dependency Rust server uses far less than 20 MB of memory
claims.measured: rust-actix/rust-axum idle 1 MB; peak 3 MB on plaintext/JSON/CPU, up to 9–10 MB on I/O and database tests
claims.why: Measured Rust servers used 1–10 MB, which is far below 20 MB as claimed.
